name: Cube Carousel
description: 3D CSS cube carousel with perspective transform, image slides, and smooth rotation.
longDescription: A visually impressive 3D cube carousel using CSS perspective transforms. Each face of the cube shows a different slide with labels, descriptions, and a badge counter. Supports Prev/Next navigation, dot indicators, and smooth 800ms transitions.

name: Tilt Product Cards
description: Draggable product card carousel with mouse-tracking 3D tilt, shine effect, and snap scrolling.
longDescription: An interactive product showcase carousel featuring cards that tilt based on mouse position with a dynamic shine highlight. Includes draggable track navigation with snap-to-card behavior, gradient edge fades, and add-to-cart CTAs.

name: Flip Card Carousel
description: 3D coverflow carousel with click-to-flip cards revealing back-side content and details.
longDescription: A cinematic 3D carousel where cards are arranged in a coverflow-style arc. Click any card to flip it 180 degrees and reveal hidden back content with titles, descriptions, and action buttons. Features perspective transforms, smooth transitions, and keyboard-friendly navigation.

name: 3D Coverflow Carousel
description: Full-screen parallax hero slider with layered depth, auto-play, and cinematic text animations.
longDescription: A cinematic full-screen hero slider with CSS parallax layers, text animation stagger effects, progress bar, and smooth auto-play with pause on hover. Each slide features a tag, headline, subtitle, and CTA button with ambient glow effects.

name: Cinematic Hero Slider
description: Full-viewport hero slider with slide transitions, Ken Burns zoom, and dual CTAs per slide.
longDescription: A high-impact full-viewport hero slider with smooth slide transitions, background image Ken Burns zoom effect, eyebrow labels, large headlines, dual CTA buttons, and side navigation bars. Auto-plays with reset on manual interaction.

name: 3D Wheel Carousel
description: Vertical 3D wheel carousel with circular item arrangement, perspective transforms, and info panel.
longDescription: A mesmerizing 3D wheel carousel where items are arranged in a vertical circle. As the wheel rotates, the active item scales up and brightens while others recede into the background. Includes a synchronized info panel with category tags, titles, descriptions, and thumb navigation.

name: Swipe Card Stack
description: Tinder-style swipeable card stack with drag physics, like/skip indicators, and shuffle reset.
longDescription: An interactive swipeable card stack similar to dating apps. Drag cards left or right to skip or like, with real-time swipe indicators. Cards behind the top card scale down slightly for a stacked deck effect. Includes reset and action buttons for keyboard/mouse users.

name: 3D Ring Carousel
description: 360-degree rotating ring carousel with drag-to-rotate, auto-spin, and active-item glow.
longDescription: A stunning 3D ring carousel that auto-rotates and responds to drag gestures. Items are placed around a circular path using trigonometric transforms. The active item glows with a colored border and shadow while inactive items dim. Includes dot navigation and active-item info display.

name: Expandable Portfolio
description: Click-to-expand portfolio cards with project details, awards, and immersive transitions.
longDescription: A unique portfolio carousel where clicking a card expands it to reveal full project details including descriptions, client info, role, awards, and a CTA. Unexpanded cards rotate slightly in 3D space for depth. Includes smooth width/height transitions and close button.

name: Parallax Layer Slider
description: Multi-layer parallax slider with mouse-reactive depth, chapter navigation, and flash transitions.
longDescription: An immersive multi-layer parallax slider where background, midground, and foreground layers move at different speeds based on mouse position. Features chapter-based content with large numbers, eyebrow labels, poetic headlines, and a flash transition effect between slides.

name: Diagonal Split Slider
description: Split-screen slider with diagonal clip-path, dual CTA layout, and skewed text animations.
longDescription: A bold split-screen carousel with a diagonal clip-path dividing text content from imagery. Each slide features a colored accent panel, skewed entrance animations, pricing display, and directional navigation. Fully responsive with a fallback to stacked layout on mobile.

name: 3D Book Flip
description: Interactive 3D book with page-turning animations, dual-page spreads, and spine effects.
longDescription: An interactive 3D book component with realistic page-turning animations using CSS perspective transforms. Each spread shows left and right pages with images, chapter titles, and body text. Includes Previous/Next controls, page indicators, and a center spine shadow for depth.

name: Hotstar Stack Carousel
description: Asymmetric stacked card carousel with fast swipe, left peek, and right shrinking stack.
longDescription: Inspired by streaming platforms, this carousel shows a center card with a small left peek and a shrinking stack of cards to the right. Supports fast-velocity swipe detection, spring physics transitions, brightness dimming for background cards, and play/add action buttons on the active card.
